StatementDateOrPeriod.name: Statement Date Or Period
StatementDateOrPeriod.definition: Date or period of the statement.

UpdateType.name: Update Type
UpdateType.definition: Indicates whether the statement is complete or contains changes only.

StatementBasis.name: Statement Basis
StatementBasis.definition: Type of balance on which the statement is prepared.

StatementType.name: Statement Type
StatementType.definition: Type of balance on which the statement is prepared.

StatementTypeRule.definition: If StatementType is used, then the statement requested must be a SecuritiesBalanceAccountingReport, a SecuritiesBalanceCustodyReport or a SecuritiesTransactionPostingReport.

StatementBasisRule.definition: If StatementBasis is used, then the statement requested must be a SecuritiesBalanceAccountingReport or a SecuritiesBalanceCustodyReport.
